source.raw_prompt: Audit demo-repo and fix a small, real, bounded gap: loanflow.config.Thresholds validates dti_low_max<=dti_medium_max, ltv_low_max<=ltv_medium_max, and the credit-score range, but never validates that max_dti_hard_fail is at or above dti_medium_max, or that max_ltv_hard_fail is at or above ltv_medium_max. A misconfigured threshold file with an inverted hard-fail/medium relationship silently makes the high-band/borderline DTI or LTV outcome unreachable (every DTI or LTV above the medium band immediately hard-fails instead of ever reaching the borderline/high-band review path), and load_thresholds's config loader currently has no check that would catch it. Add the missing invariant to Thresholds.__post_init__, raising ConfigError exactly like the existing invariants, plus regression tests in demo-repo/tests/unit/test_config.py.

objective: Add a config invariant to loanflow.config.Thresholds ensuring max_dti_hard_fail is not below dti_medium_max and max_ltv_hard_fail is not below ltv_medium_max, so a misconfigured threshold file can never silently make the borderline/high-band DTI or LTV rule outcome unreachable.
constraints: No new dependencies without written justification
No change to Thresholds' public field shape (same dataclass fields, same constructor signature)

Extend the existing __post_init__ validation pattern (raise loanflow.errors.ConfigError, mirroring the existing dti_low_max/dti_medium_max and ltv_low_max/ltv_medium_max invariant checks) rather than introducing a new validation mechanism

acceptance_criteria.description: Constructing Thresholds with max_dti_hard_fail below dti_medium_max raises loanflow.errors.ConfigError
Constructing Thresholds with max_ltv_hard_fail below ltv_medium_max raises loanflow.errors.ConfigError
All tests in demo-repo/tests/unit/test_config.py pass, including the two new regression tests above, and DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS still constructs successfully under the new invariant

task_graph.description: Confirm Thresholds.__post_init__'s current invariant checks and error type, and confirm DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS already satisfies the proposed new invariant
Add the max_dti_hard_fail/dti_medium_max and max_ltv_hard_fail/ltv_medium_max invariant checks to Thresholds.__post_init__ and add regression tests
Verify the narrow test_config.py suite and the full demo-repo test suite
